gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i2: Tests for {@link MatchRatingApproachEncoder}, the Match Rating Approach (MRA) phonetic encoder.

The tests are grouped by the method under test:
ADDED i4: "," and "-" are stripped by cleanName, leaving nothing to encode.
ADDED i5: "ec": no vowels removed beyond rules, short enough to keep as-is, upper-cased.
ADDED i6: Leading vowel 'I' is kept; the trailing '[' survives cleaning.
ADDED i7: A word longer than 6 letters after processing is reduced to its first 3 + last 3.
ADDED i8: Every supported accented character; accents are removed prior to encoding.
ADDED i12: After cleaning, ",-l" and "RR" reduce to the same encoding.
ADDED i14: sumLength > 12 -> minimum rating of 1.
ADDED i15: sumLength == 12 -> minimum rating of 2.
ADDED i17: Identical strings cancel out completely, leaving 6 - 0 = 6.
